lore:
After eons of solitude, that person's appearance was like a sudden light in the deep ocean, igniting the long-dormant seabed.
Eager for a fair duel, Lotan willingly took on a human form, quietly awaiting the growth of a worthy opponent—she had yearned for an intense battle for far too long.
